name: Flora Parasocial
source:
Audiences connect to their favorite celebrities all the time. How does it affect these people when put into a game of life or death? Only time will tell.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4683170/Flora_Parasocial/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
观众无时无刻不在与自己喜爱的明星建立单向的情感联结。倘若将这些人投进一场生死攸关的游戏之中，这份依恋又会给他们带来怎样的影响？唯有时间能给出答案。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4683170/Flora_Parasocial/]Steam[/url]]
